units.source_text: 源氏此时正在三公主处。

en.t: Genji was then with the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 他突然开了界门，走进明石女御房中来了。

en.t: He suddenly opened the partition door and came into the Akashi Consort's room.

units.source_text: 明石夫人来不及将文件箱隐藏，便把帷屏稍稍拉近，将箱遮掩，自己也躲在帷屏背后了。

en.t: Lady Akashi had no time to hide the document box, so she drew the curtain screen a little closer to conceal it and hid herself behind the screen as well.

units.source_text: 源氏说：“小皇子醒了没有？

en.t: Genji said, "Has the young prince awakened?

units.source_text: 我一刻不见，便想念他。”

en.t: If I do not see him even for a moment, I miss him."

units.source_text: 明石女御默默不答。

en.t: The Akashi Consort remained silent and did not answer.

units.source_text: 明石夫人从帷屏后面答道：“小皇子给紫夫人抱去了。”

en.t: Lady Akashi answered from behind the screen, "Lady Murasaki has taken the young prince in her arms."

units.source_text: 源氏说：“这太不成话了。

en.t: Genji said, "That is really unreasonable.

units.source_text: 成天价在那边，这小皇子被她一人独占了。

en.t: He is over there all day long, and she has the young prince all to herself.

units.source_text: 她一直抱在怀中，不肯放手，弄得衣服都湿透，一件一件地更换。

en.t: She keeps holding him in her arms and will not let him go, until her robes are soaked and she has to change them one by one.

units.source_text: 为什么这样轻率地让她抱去呢？

en.t: Why did you let her carry him off so casually?

units.source_text: 应该叫她到这里来看才是。”

en.t: You should have told her to come here to see him."

units.source_text: 明石夫人答道：“哎呀，这话太不体谅人了！

en.t: Lady Akashi replied, "Oh my, that is terribly inconsiderate of you to say!

units.source_text: 即使是个皇女，由她抚育也最为妥善，何况是个皇子。

en.t: Even if the child were a princess, it would be best for her to raise the child, and all the more so when he is a prince.

units.source_text: 身份固然高贵无比，但在那边不是很可放心的么？

en.t: His rank is of course exceedingly noble, but is he not very safe over there?

units.source_text: 虽然是说笑，也不要过分苛刻地说这种冷酷的话呀！”

en.t: Even if you are joking, please do not speak such harsh and cold words."

units.source_text: 源氏笑道：“那么，听凭你们做主，我就一切不管好了。

en.t: Genji laughed and said, "In that case, I shall leave everything to you all and have nothing more to do with it.

units.source_text: 你们大家都排斥我，对我说话神气活现，真可笑。

en.t: All of you shut me out and speak to me so proudly; it is quite amusing.

units.source_text: 现在你就躲在帷屏背后板起了面孔责备我。”

en.t: Even now you are hiding behind the screen with a stern face, scolding me."

units.source_text: 说着，便把帷屏拉开，但见明石夫人将身体靠在正屋的柱子上，姿态非常美丽，教人看了自觉羞愧。

en.t: As he spoke, he pulled the screen aside and saw Lady Akashi leaning against a pillar of the main room, so beautifully poised that anyone looking at her would feel ashamed.

units.source_text: 刚才那只文件箱，未便慌忙隐藏，照旧放在那里。

en.t: The document box from earlier could not be hastily hidden, and it still lay there as before.

units.source_text: 源氏看到了，问道：“这是什么箱子？

en.t: Genji noticed it and asked, "What is this box?

units.source_text: 看样子是情人欲寄相思，把所咏的长歌封入这箱子里送来的吧。”

en.t: From the look of it, some lover must have sealed a long poem of longing in this box and sent it to you."

units.source_text: 明石夫人答道：“唉，真讨厌啊！

en.t: Lady Akashi answered, "Oh, how dreadful!

units.source_text: 你自己变了个老少年，就常常说这种使人意想不到的笑话。”

en.t: You yourself have become an old boy, and you are always making such unexpected jokes."

units.source_text: 她口角微露笑容，但是脸上显然心事满腹。

en.t: A faint smile appeared at the corners of her mouth, but her face plainly showed that she was full of anxious thoughts.

units.source_text: 源氏觉得奇怪，侧着头不解其意。

en.t: Genji found it strange and tilted his head, unable to understand what she meant.

units.source_text: 明石夫人为难了，便说：“这是那明石浦上的岩屋里送来的，里面藏着我父亲私下祈祷时所读的经卷，以及尚未酬偿的祈愿。

en.t: Lady Akashi was troubled and said, "This was sent from the rock dwelling on Akashi Bay; inside are sutra scrolls my father read during his private prayers, along with vows that have not yet been fulfilled.

units.source_text: 他说倘有机会，可否给你看看。

en.t: He said that if there were an opportunity, perhaps I might show them to you.

units.source_text: 但是现在尚非其时，所以不必打开。”

en.t: But now is not yet the time, so there is no need to open it."

units.source_text: 源氏想起了明石道人那种可怜的模样，说道：“道人的修行功夫一定积得很深了吧。

en.t: Genji remembered the pitiful figure of the Akashi Novice and said, "The Novice must surely have accumulated deep merit through his religious practice.

units.source_text: 他很寿长，多年勤勉修持，可以消除不少罪障。

en.t: He has lived long and practiced diligently for many years, so he must have erased many karmic hindrances.

units.source_text: 世间原有身份高贵、学问渊博的人，然而对于尘世浊虑，习染亦深，故虽曰贤惠，亦甚有限，总不及这位道人的清高。

en.t: There are indeed people in the world of high rank and vast learning, but they are also deeply stained by the muddy concerns of this world, so even if they are called wise and virtuous, their virtue has limits and never reaches the purity of this Novice.

units.source_text: 他对于佛道造诣极深，而为人又颇有风趣。

en.t: He had profound understanding of the Buddhist Way, and his character also had considerable charm.

units.source_text: 他没有高僧那种解脱尘世的态度，然而内心纯净无垢，直通净土。

en.t: He did not have the manner of a great priest detached from the world, yet his inner heart was pure and unstained, leading straight to the Pure Land.

units.source_text: 何况现在已经心无挂碍，便可完全脱离俗世了。

en.t: And now that his heart has no attachments, he can surely leave the secular world completely behind.

units.source_text: 我若能随意行动，颇想悄悄地前去探望他呢。”

en.t: If I were free to go where I wished, I would very much like to visit him quietly."

units.source_text: 明石夫人说：“据说他现已离弃原来的住处，遁入鸟声也听不到的深山中去了。”

en.t: Lady Akashi said, "I am told that he has now abandoned his former dwelling and gone deep into mountains where even birdsong cannot be heard."

units.source_text: 源氏说：“如此说来，这是他的遗言了！

en.t: Genji said, "Then this must be his final testament!

units.source_text: 有否通过消息？

en.t: Has any word passed between you?

units.source_text: 师姑老太太想必悲伤不堪吧。

en.t: The old nun must surely be overwhelmed with grief.

units.source_text: 须知夫妻之情，比父女之谊深切得多呢。”

en.t: You must know that the bond between husband and wife is far deeper than the tie between father and daughter."

units.source_text: 说着流下泪来。

en.t: As he said this, tears flowed from his eyes.

units.source_text: 随后又说：“我年纪大起来，渐渐了解种种人情世故之后，想起了道人的风貌品质，便觉得怪可思慕。

en.t: Then he continued, "As I grow older and gradually come to understand all kinds of human feelings and worldly affairs, when I think of the Novice's bearing and character, I find him strangely dear and admirable.

units.source_text: 何况师姑老太太与他结发情深，这别离该是多么伤心啊！”

en.t: How much more heartbreaking this parting must be for the old nun, who has shared such deep affection with him since their youth!"
